profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Garmin International

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Manage hundreds of APIs for updates to Garmin units.
Monitoring millions of API requests a day.
Large Angular Material application for internal use to manage map releases.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Revenue Cycle - Patient Accounting
-Required to learn new languages fast to be able to complete work on the team
-Developed with Cerner’s in house scripting language CCL
-Developed directly on applications that are used by Cerner’s clients
-Refactored legacy code to bring it back up to Cerner’s coding standards
-Improved efficiency and code quality of CCL scripts
-Learned valuable skills while working with code that is regulated through the FDA

positions.title: Software Contractor
positions.description:
Maverick
- Worked as a software engineer intern for Maverick Software Consulting, a collaborative effort between Maverick Software Consulting and Thomson Reuters, which allows students to gain real world IT experience
- Over 2 years of real world experience in the industry
- Utilized Java, Eclipse, Selenium, XPath, Microsoft Team Foundation Server, and many Thomson Reuter made utilities


Thomson Reuters

Dataroom
- API testing for hundreds of API's that are used throughout multiple Thomson Reuter applications
- Managed over 17,000 tests and analyzed daily test results.
- Created multiple utilities that saved man hours that would make API testing more efficient and effective
- Wrote testing scripts that would be executed through an automated system for testing
- Created hundreds of new and unique API tests
- Participated in daily stand up meetings to go over the team’s progress and goals
- Responsible for completing assigned tasks in a given matter of time
- Utilized Java and various scripting languages

Performance Testing
- Created a brand new automated system for managing test results. This would end up saving thousands of man hours
- Goal of this project was to hit API's 10% above what production is hitting them at. This was to make sure the servers could handle a load above normal usage
- Started the move of changing the test execution location by setting up virtual testing servers
- Utilized C for testing, Java and TFS for test result handling

TRAMS
- Web UI testing on over 40 Thomson Reuter in-house applications
- Gave code reviews on team members work before it is merged with the master build
- Created hundreds of new tests using Selenium
- Discovered and reported many bugs directly to the developers of the tested application using TFS
- Participated in weekly meetings to go over progress on assigned tasks and any other concerns
- Utilized Java, XPath, Selenium, and TFS
